purpose: Single skeleton-first implementation specification consolidating the proportion/geometry audits before a new Blender canonical target is built.
global_rules: The anatomical skeleton is the source of truth. The mesh is later refit around the frozen skeleton.
Do not preserve a003 dimensions merely because they sit inside the r95 mesh.
Do not replace every a003 dimension blindly: retain independently corroborated anchors.
Every numeric target must carry a measurement definition and source context.
Whole-bone geometry, joint-centre geometry, surface measurements and control-stick spans are distinct data types.
Adult 206-bone count is preserved. Non-bone discs, cartilage, contact frames, centrelines and helper markers do not add anatomical bones.
Conflicting population or measurement-definition evidence must reopen a target rather than be averaged silently.

retain: local GH depth below acromion provisionally
blockers: exact stature-aware SC-to-AC/centreline target not frozen
hard_invariants: SC-to-AC straight endpoint span < clavicle curved centreline length
AC and GH never collapse to one centre
scapular GH-to-inferior-angle span is validated against a 3D scapular height/width/glenoid envelope, not height alone
shoulder_girdle.note: Clavicle proportion defect is directly confirmed. Scapular geometry is strongly reopened, but the exact shortening is not frozen because GH-to-inferior-angle is an oblique 3D span.

hard_invariants: disc-bearing adjacent vertebrae do not share identical endplate points
C1/C2 and C0/C1 do not receive invented discs
body height and disc height are measured/tested separately
curve data are reference geometry, not extra bones
radius and ulna are not scaled as one segment
PRUJ and DRUJ remain distinct and congruent

verify: all digit-specific phalange ratios before freeze

carpus.hard_invariant: equal arbitrary control-stick template is not freeze-ready anatomy

pelvis.hard_invariant: do not shift a corroborated HJC merely to stay inside the old mesh

lower_limb_long_bones.hard_invariant: plausible size does not substitute for correct contact mechanics

tarsus.hard_invariant: control-stick length is never treated as whole-bone length

confirmed: r95/a003 heel-to-toe surface foot length is too long for the stature-conditioned ANSUR corridor
unresolved: which share of the excess length belongs to hindfoot/midfoot geometry, metatarsals, toe phalanges and terminal soft tissue
retain_provisionally: a003 M1/M2 length as plausible starting values only; do not freeze
rebuild: toe joint/tip geometry with explicit soft-tissue allowance
mesh length after the internal skeletal chain is frozen
forefoot_toes.hard_invariant: final heel-to-toe mesh length comes from canonical bone/contact chain plus explicit soft tissue; no metatarsal is shortened solely to match one unconditioned population mean

head_neck_fixed_bones.note: Exercise kinematic priority is lower than shoulder/spine/limbs, but geometry must be freeze-ready before calling the complete reference skeleton final.

implementation_order: 1 shoulder girdle: fix the gross SC/AC/scapula proportions that directly affect overhead mechanics
2 spine + discs: separate real vertebral bodies from disc spacing and re-establish thoracic/rib anchors
3 ribs: add curved centrelines and true rib-neck axes
4 forearm/wrist/carpus/hand: retarget distal upper limb and preserve PRUJ/DRUJ mechanics
5 tarsus/forefoot/toes: rebuild foot skeleton and shorten mesh later
6 pelvis details + fibula/patella contacts: refine amber regions without disturbing corroborated anchors
8 rerun isolated joint tests on the new skeleton before any whole-body exercise tests
9 only after skeleton gates pass: refit/rebuild mesh, weights and correctives
required_before_new_blender_candidate: all RED regions have machine-readable target corridors/landmarks
every proposed numeric change cites a matching measurement definition
new candidate gets a new immutable audit revision; a003 remains unchanged for comparison
foot target reconciliation resolves stature-aware metatarsal evidence before any forefoot shortening
